description: e.p.t.q. (EPTQ) is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler line from the South Korean manufacturer Jetema, supplied in three viscosity/density grades: S100, S300 and S500. The range spans superficial fine-line correction through to deep volumising and structural augmentation, with lidocaine and non-lidocaine options. Each grade shares the same HA concentration but differs in cross-linking density and gel firmness (G-prime) to suit the treatment plane.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel restores volume by occupying tissue space and binding water to hydrate and plump the dermis. Lower-density grades (S100) sit in the superficial dermis for fine lines, while higher-density, higher-G-prime grades (S300/S500) resist deformation and are placed deeper for lift and projection; indication and depth therefore track gel firmness and particle characteristics.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid of non-animal (bacterial fermentation) origin at approximately 24 mg/mL, available with or without lidocaine hydrochloride (typically 0.3%) for injection comfort.
usageNotes: Supplied as sterile, single-use prefilled syringes for intradermal-to-subcutaneous injection by trained practitioners; match grade firmness to the intended plane, inject slowly with care to avoid intravascular placement, and avoid overcorrection. HA-based, so results are adjustable and can be dissolved with hyaluronidase if correction is required. Store and handle per the product label.
features: Three graded viscosities (S100/S300/S500) from one platform
Consistent HA concentration with grade-specific cross-linking density
Optional lidocaine formulations for injection comfort
Non-animal HA sourced by bacterial fermentation
benefits: Single supplier line covers fine-line to deep-volume indications, simplifying inventory
Grade selection lets clinicians standardise protocols by treatment plane
Lidocaine options reduce chair time and improve patient experience
Reversibility with hyaluronidase supports predictable case management
Recognised Korean-manufactured HA line suitable for enquiry-to-order catalogues
indications: Superficial/fine lines and periorbital or perioral wrinkles (S100)
Deep folds, cheek and mid-face volumising (S300/S500)

description: Kairax is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler manufactured in South Korea by Victoria Sun Inc., offered in three variants: Fine, Deep and Sub-Q. Each variant is formulated with lidocaine and positioned across superficial correction, mid-dermal volumising and deep contouring. The range targets a comfortable treatment experience with reduced swelling and precise placement.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water to rehydrate and fill the treated plane. Fine (low viscosity) is placed superficially for delicate areas, Deep (medium viscoelasticity) addresses folds and lip volume, and Sub-Q (highest firmness/G-prime) is implanted subcutaneously for structural lift; depth and indication follow the gel's particle size and viscoelastic profile.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid at approximately 20 mg/mL with 0.3% lidocaine included across the Fine, Deep and Sub-Q variants.
usageNotes: Sterile single-use prefilled syringes for practitioner administration; select the variant to match injection depth, inject slowly and avoid intravascular delivery and overcorrection. As an HA filler it is adjustable and can be dissolved with hyaluronidase if correction is needed. Follow label storage and handling.
features: Fine / Deep / Sub-Q variants for graded depth
Positioned for reduced swelling and precise placement
benefits: Full-depth coverage from one brand for streamlined ordering
Built-in lidocaine improves patient comfort and workflow
Consistent formulation supports repeatable clinical protocols
HA reversibility aids risk management and correction
Competitively positioned Korean filler for B2B catalogues
indications: Fine lines and superficial periorbital/perioral wrinkles (Fine)
Nasolabial folds, glabellar and marionette lines (Deep)

description: UnionFill is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler produced by Double J Holdings (Seoul), available in Soft, Deep and Hard viscosities. It is built on a homogeneous HA cross-linking approach intended to give a uniform gel matrix with stable viscosity over the treatment window. Each variant carries lidocaine for injection comfort and covers superficial fine lines through to structural augmentation.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and draws in water to hydrate and support the tissue. Soft (lowest viscosity) targets upper-dermal fine lines, Deep (mid viscosity) addresses folds and cheek contour, and Hard (highest firmness/G-prime) is used for lip volume and structural augmentation; placement depth follows the gel's viscoelasticity and cross-link density.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid at 24 mg/mL with lidocaine 3 mg/mL, supplied in 1.0 mL prefilled syringes; supplier testing reports BDDE residue not detected.
usageNotes: Sterile single-use prefilled syringes for trained injectors; match variant firmness to the plane, inject slowly with aspiration/awareness of vasculature, and avoid overcorrection. HA-based and therefore adjustable and reversible with hyaluronidase. Store and handle per label.
benefits: Uniform matrix aims for consistent flow and predictable results
Three grades cover the full depth range for simplified stock
Integrated lidocaine supports patient comfort
Reversibility with hyaluronidase supports correction
Documented low-residue profile suits clinical procurement

description: Sosum is a series of cross-linked hyaluronic acid fillers from the South Korean manufacturer JSBIO Co., Ltd., produced with a proprietary Low Temperature Stabilization Reaction (LTSR) process. The line comprises three grades - Sosum-S, Sosum-M and Sosum-H - which differ in gel particle size and firmness for fine, medium and deep correction respectively. It is positioned as a high-density, degradation-resistant HA platform.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel restores volume and binds water to hydrate and fill the treatment plane. Sosum-S (finer particles) suits superficial fine lines, Sosum-M targets medium wrinkles and mid-dermal volume, and Sosum-H (largest particles, highest G-prime) is placed deeper for deep wrinkles and contouring; indication and depth scale with particle size and viscoelasticity.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (of non-animal origin) at approximately 20 mg/mL, produced via LTSR cross-linking; lidocaine may be included depending on the SKU/market.
usageNotes: Sterile single-use prefilled syringes for practitioner use; choose the grade to match injection depth, inject slowly, avoid intravascular placement and overcorrection. As an HA gel it is adjustable and dissolvable with hyaluronidase if needed. Follow label storage and handling.
features: S / M / H grades by particle size and firmness
benefits: Three grades cover fine-to-deep correction from one line
Density-focused technology positioned for longevity of effect
Consistent grade behaviour supports repeatable protocols
HA reversibility supports correction and risk control
Korean-manufactured platform suitable for B2B enquiry-to-order

description: Flawless is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler line offered in Fine, Deep and Sub-Q variants and commonly supplied as 2 x 1 mL (2cc) prefilled syringes. The brand promotes a multi-layered 'Phasic' gel structure - combining biphasic and monophasic characteristics - intended to balance moldability with lifting capacity. A specific legal manufacturer could not be independently verified, so the manufacturer is left unconfirmed.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water to hydrate and support the tissue. Fine (lower viscosity) is placed superficially for early lines and subtle lip work, Deep addresses folds and mid-face volume, and Sub-Q (highest firmness/G-prime) is implanted subcutaneously for deep volume and framing; the treatment depth follows the gel's viscoelastic and particle profile.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid at approximately 20 mg/mL with 0.3% lidocaine (variant/market dependent); non-animal origin, typically supplied as 2 x 1 mL syringes.
usageNotes: Sterile single-use prefilled syringes for trained injectors; match variant to the plane, inject slowly, avoid intravascular placement and overcorrection. HA-based, so it is adjustable and can be dissolved with hyaluronidase for correction. Store and handle per label.
features: Positioned for reduced swelling and easy hyaluronidase correction
benefits: Depth-graded variants cover a wide indication range
2cc pack format offers value per treatment for clinics
Integrated lidocaine improves patient comfort
HA reversibility supports predictable correction
Broadly distributed Korean filler suited to enquiry-to-order
indications: Fine lines and early aging signs (Fine)

description: StarFill is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler series from the South Korean manufacturer Jetema, produced using its ZEEP cross-linking technology and supplied with lidocaine. The line comprises StarFill Plus, StarFill Deep Plus and StarFill Implant Plus, which vary in cross-linking rate and gel particle size for superficial, moderate-to-deep and structural/lip indications. It is positioned around low residual BDDE and endotoxin for a favourable safety profile.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water to hydrate and fill the tissue plane. Plus (finer, softer gel) treats superficial/fine wrinkles, Deep Plus targets moderate-to-severe lines and mid-face volume, and Implant Plus (firmest, highest G-prime) is used for facial volumising and lip augmentation; depth and indication scale with particle size and gel firmness.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid at approximately 24 mg/mL with lidocaine, manufactured via ZEEP cross-linking (positioned for minimised residual BDDE and endotoxin).
usageNotes: Sterile single-use prefilled syringes for practitioner administration; select the grade for the target plane, inject slowly and avoid intravascular placement and overcorrection. HA-based and therefore adjustable and reversible with hyaluronidase. Store and handle per label.

description: Eloquence is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler line developed by the South Korean manufacturer Jetema, available in Fine, Deep and Sub-Q formulations. It is a high-viscoelasticity, monophasic-style HA gel supplied with lidocaine and positioned for smooth administration via optimised injection pressure. The grades target different skin depths from superficial correction to subcutaneous structural augmentation.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water to rehydrate and support the tissue. Fine (lower viscosity) is placed superficially, Deep addresses folds and mid-face volume, and Sub-Q (highest density/G-prime) is implanted subcutaneously for strong lift and contour; placement depth and indication follow the gel's viscoelasticity and particle profile.
composition: Highly cross-linked hyaluronic acid of non-animal origin at approximately 24 mg/mL with lidocaine, characterised in supplier data by high viscoelasticity and very low endotoxin content.
usageNotes: Sterile single-use prefilled syringes for trained injectors; match the grade to the treatment plane, inject slowly and avoid intravascular delivery and overcorrection. HA-based and adjustable, and reversible with hyaluronidase if correction is required. Follow label storage and handling.

description: Monalisa is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler line from the South Korean manufacturer GENOSS Co., Ltd., produced with proprietary Hy-BRID cross-linking technology to create uniform, densely packed HA particles. The range comprises four grades - Soft, Mild, Hard and Ultra - differentiated by particle size (approximately 200 to 900 microns) and firmness for depths from tear-trough to structural contouring. It is a non-animal, fermentation-derived HA platform positioned for high viscoelasticity and durability.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water to hydrate and support the treated plane. Soft (smallest particles) suits fine/superficial and tear-trough work, Mild adds mid-dermal volume, Hard addresses deeper wrinkles and sculpting, and Ultra (largest particles, highest G-prime) is used for strong structural lines; depth and indication scale directly with particle size and gel firmness.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid of non-animal (fermentation) origin at approximately 24 mg/mL, produced by Hy-BRID cross-linking with graded particle sizes; Ultra (and select grades) formulated with lidocaine.
usageNotes: Sterile single-use prefilled syringes for practitioner use; select the grade to match particle size and injection depth, inject slowly and avoid intravascular placement and overcorrection. HA-based and therefore adjustable and dissolvable with hyaluronidase for correction. Store and handle per label.
